nonblocking.what: The §十·三·三 classification table in DELIVERY.md:360 still says it classifies 'ROUND8-GREP.txt 的 17 条命中'. The brief and ROUND9-GREP.txt use 19, the 2 extra being the two occurrences on line :369 of the table itself. Also, `HITS=19` counts occurrences, while grep -n reports 9 lines; the two counting methods aren't explained, so a reader can easily mistake them for a discrepancy. Next time, label it something like 'occurrences=19 / lines=9'.

The pointer at DELIVERY.md:269, `正是第 8 轮 N4 抓到的误引，见 §十一`, is wrong. N4 is handled at §十·三 (:329); §十一 is the current-status table and doesn't mention N4. This is a cross-reference error, not part of the four criteria, and doesn't affect C1's classification.

I checked mtimes against the brief's actual mtime: DELIVERY 18:26:05 / CITE-CHECK 18:28:25 / ledger 18:22:15 / AGENTS 18:26:38 / LESSONS 18:17:54 are all earlier, and the sizes match FREEZE-round9.txt one by one (38176 / 260 / 109400 / 42256 / 31547 B).
